about: A saved measurement's PDF report, through the report its kind uses, read back line by line and compared with `<fixture>.guitartap.pdf.txt` (Swift's lines: page, baseline from the page's top, text). Each line within 'baselineTolerance' points; words compared with whitespace removed, in Unicode compatibility form; the date and the "Generated by" line by position only. The PDF readers stay per edition (PDFKit, pypdf, pdf.js).
